name: religion
description: Gods, beliefs, rites, laws, symbols, orders, holy places, and magic

fields.name: The Hearthmother
fields.deity_or_belief: A maternal fire deity protecting home, kin, hospitality, and honest labor.
fields.rites: Share the first portion of every communal meal with a stranger.
fields.commandment: No guest may be harmed beneath a welcomed roof.
fields.taboo: Extinguishing another family's hearth without consent.
fields.sacred_symbol: Three flames inside an open circle.
fields.holy_place: The First Hearth, said to have burned since civilization began.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Blesses wards, healing warmth, food, and protection from cold.

fields.name: The Open Road
fields.deity_or_belief: A path-god who teaches that movement, exchange, and curiosity prevent tyranny.
fields.rites: Leave a marked stone at crossroads and carry news between settlements.
fields.commandment: Offer directions and water to peaceful travelers.
fields.taboo: Blocking a public road for private gain.
fields.sacred_symbol: A forked road beneath a rising sun.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Supports speed, navigation, safe passage, and dimensional travel.

fields.name: The Quiet Judge
fields.deity_or_belief: An impartial death deity who weighs memory, responsibility, and unfinished promises.
fields.rites: Speak the dead person's deeds truthfully before burial.
fields.commandment: Do not hide a death or deny the dead their name.
fields.taboo: Binding a soul to its corpse.
fields.sacred_symbol: A closed eye above balanced scales.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Permits funerary wards and communication with willing spirits, forbids coercive necromancy.

fields.name: Lady of Tides
fields.deity_or_belief: A sea goddess of change, trade, storms, mourning, and safe return.
fields.rites: Cast salt and a personal token into the water before voyages.
fields.commandment: Rescue the shipwrecked regardless of allegiance.
fields.taboo: Claiming ownership of the sea or denying burial to sailors.
fields.sacred_symbol: A silver wave crossing a black moon.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Favors water, weather, divination, and transformation magic.

fields.name: The Seven Smiths
fields.deity_or_belief: Seven divine siblings embodying invention, patience, repair, craft, fire, measure, and teaching.
fields.rites: Present a useful handmade object at adulthood.
fields.commandment: Repair before replacing and teach any willing apprentice.
fields.taboo: Intentionally designing a tool to fail its user.
fields.sacred_symbol: Seven hammers around an anvil.
fields.holy_place: The Resonant Forge beneath Mount Orun.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Treats enchantment as craft requiring makers' marks, testing, and accountability.

fields.name: The Green Pact
fields.deity_or_belief: Life is a negotiated balance among people, beasts, plants, decay, and seasons.
fields.rites: Return part of every harvest or hunt to uncultivated land.
fields.commandment: Take no population below its power to recover.
fields.taboo: Creating life unable to reproduce or die naturally.
fields.sacred_symbol: Leaf, fang, and mushroom joined in a triangle.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Welcomes healing and nature magic but distrusts permanent artificial life.

fields.name: The Unconquered Sun
fields.deity_or_belief: A solar warrior deity representing courage, truth, discipline, and public justice.
fields.rites: Confess one fear at dawn and face it before sunset.
fields.commandment: Defend those who cannot safely defend themselves.
fields.taboo: Secret punishment without accusation or witness.
fields.sacred_symbol: A golden eye surrounded by eight rays.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Grants light, truth, courage, and power against undead or deception.

fields.name: The Moon Weaver
fields.deity_or_belief: A shifting lunar deity who governs dreams, secrets, art, illusion, and identity.
fields.rites: Create an anonymous work of beauty each new moon.
fields.commandment: Protect harmless secrets entrusted freely.
fields.taboo: Stealing another person's true name.
fields.sacred_symbol: A crescent threaded by a silver needle.
fields.holy_place: The Gallery Seen Only in Dreams.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Celebrates illusion and dream magic while condemning permanent theft of identity.

fields.name: The Thunder King
fields.deity_or_belief: A loud, generous storm god of oaths, competition, rulership, and rain.
fields.rites: Swear major promises outdoors during a storm or before struck metal.
fields.commandment: Keep public oaths even when they become costly.
fields.taboo: Whispering an oath so witnesses cannot hear it.
fields.sacred_symbol: A split crown struck by lightning.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Empowers lightning, weather, voices, and oath-bound effects.

fields.name: The Thousand Ancestors
fields.deity_or_belief: Families remain communities across death, and the living inherit both debts and wisdom.
fields.rites: Maintain household name tablets and consult them on major decisions.
fields.commandment: Leave descendants a better name than you received.
fields.taboo: Erasing someone from the family record.
fields.sacred_symbol: A branching tree filled with small faces.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Allows voluntary ancestral guidance, protective spirits, and inherited memory.

fields.name: The Liberating Flame
fields.deity_or_belief: A revolutionary sacred fire that destroys bondage, fear, and unjust hierarchy.
fields.rites: Burn a symbol of submission during yearly renewal festivals.
fields.commandment: Help captives who ask for freedom.
fields.taboo: Owning another thinking being.
fields.sacred_symbol: A broken chain glowing red.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Breaks bindings, compulsions, prisons, and sometimes useful restraints.

fields.name: The Perfect Measure
fields.deity_or_belief: Cosmic order is revealed through mathematics, proportion, contracts, and predictable law.
fields.rites: Audit personal debts and correct false measurements each month.
fields.commandment: Use one standard for yourself and others.
fields.taboo: Altering records after agreement.
fields.sacred_symbol: A compass inside a square.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Prefers runes, geometry, wards, contracts, and repeatable spellcraft.

fields.name: The Nameless Mercy
fields.deity_or_belief: A hidden god teaches goodness without reward, recognition, or permanent institutions.
fields.rites: Perform aid anonymously and never reveal it.
fields.commandment: Help where gratitude cannot benefit you.
fields.taboo: Building monuments to personal charity.
fields.sacred_symbol: An empty white cloth.
fields.religious_order: No acknowledged order; followers recognize subtle signs.
fields.holy_place: Any unmarked grave repaired by a stranger.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Miracles become weaker when publicly claimed or credited.

fields.name: The Devouring Cycle
fields.deity_or_belief: Creation, consumption, death, and rebirth are one sacred process without moral preference.
fields.rites: Consume a symbolic part of what one destroys and plant something after funerals.
fields.commandment: Waste nothing taken from life.
fields.taboo: Preserving the dead indefinitely.
fields.sacred_symbol: A serpent eating a sprouting seed.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Supports transformation and renewal, opposes immortality and undeath.

fields.name: The Sleeping Mountain
fields.deity_or_belief: An ancient earth-being dreams beneath the world and rewards patience, endurance, and silence.
fields.rites: Keep one day of complete silence during winter.
fields.commandment: Do not answer temporary anger with permanent action.
fields.taboo: Mining beneath consecrated peaks.
fields.sacred_symbol: A closed eye carved into stone.
fields.holy_place: The Cavern of the First Dream.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Grants stone, sleep, endurance, and prophetic dreams measured in years.

fields.name: The Laughing Mask
fields.deity_or_belief: A trickster deity exposes pride, rigid authority, and lies through humor and reversal.
fields.rites: Officials exchange roles with servants during the Feast of Errors.
fields.commandment: Mock power before mocking weakness.
fields.taboo: Punishing a joke that reveals a true abuse.
fields.sacred_symbol: A two-colored smiling mask.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Favors disguise, luck, illusion, escape, and curses triggered by arrogance.

fields.name: The Star Pilgrims
fields.deity_or_belief: Mortal souls originate among the stars and must learn enough to navigate home.
fields.rites: Record one new observation of the sky each clear night.
fields.commandment: Share discoveries that change humanity's place in creation.
fields.taboo: Destroying astronomical knowledge.
fields.sacred_symbol: A seven-pointed star above an open eye.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Encourages divination, gravity, light, and travel beyond the world.

fields.name: The Red Communion
fields.deity_or_belief: Shared blood proves that all thinking peoples belong to one vulnerable family.
fields.rites: Healers and leaders donate blood during public covenant ceremonies.
fields.commandment: Treat another's wound before pursuing revenge.
fields.taboo: Using blood taken without consent in magic.
fields.sacred_symbol: Two hands joined by a red line.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Permits consensual blood healing and condemns sacrificial coercion.

fields.name: The Door Beyond
fields.deity_or_belief: Reality contains countless worlds, and hospitality must extend to responsible visitors from each.
fields.rites: Keep an empty place at major feasts for an unknown guest.
fields.commandment: Judge outsiders by conduct rather than origin.
fields.taboo: Opening a passage without preparing a safe return.
fields.sacred_symbol: An open door filled with stars.
fields.holy_place: The Hall of One Hundred Doors.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Regulates summoning, portals, banishment, and interplanar diplomacy.

fields.name: The Crowned Serpent
fields.deity_or_belief: A god of ambition teaches that power is sacred only when continually proven useful.
fields.rites: Leaders publicly defend one decision before critics each season.
fields.commandment: Use authority to create achievements that outlive you.
fields.taboo: Claiming rank without accepting its risks.
fields.sacred_symbol: A serpent coiled through a crown.
fields.relationship_with_magic: Rewards domination, command, transformation, and dangerous tests of worth.
